name: Wave Runner
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Native (Skia) port of the Waveform Builder rendering engine. Pixel-equivalent output to the WebView TopVis with full feature parity: bars + line layers, every colour mode, asymmetric attack/release smoothing, contrast/tilt, response curves, mirror/elastic/spline/fill — only fxFade and post-blur are deferred. A `style` parameter switches between hardcoded preset waves (bars / bars+mirror line / bars+fill / line only) so the user can A/B against the JS engine without recompiling.
